title: the outcome of a spawned task that nobody awaits is destroyed when its owner closes
purpose: A spawned Future owns its outcome; a task that is never awaited still releases what it made, exactly once, at the close of the scope that owns the Future.

stdout.text:
owner
destroy inner
after owner
main
destroy outer

provenance.origin: authored for #768 from the cited contract text and the ruling recorded in the ticket
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.9 and Bible 11.9: a task that is never awaited still releases what it owns; 11.4: destroy runs once, when the owning scope ends. The Future is owned by the scope that spawned it (OIR-2 async ABI D24.2: the owner's close releases the outcome), so `inner` is destroyed when `owner` ends, before `after owner`, and `outer` when `main` ends.
